do_one_case:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads and sorts N points, groups every ordered point pair by normalized direction, then for each direction constructs source-based collinear chains and uses parity-based merging to compute a maximum score, printing the best score as Case #cnum." do_one_case]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read integer N from input using rd1int(). RESULT N]
            [COMMAND Initialize XY as an empty list. RESULT XY]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to N-1 inclusive, read two integers x and y using rdints(), and append the tuple (x, y) to XY. RESULT XY]
            [COMMAND Sort XY in lexicographic order. RESULT XY]
            [COMMAND Initialize A as an empty dictionary mapping normalized direction tuples to lists of directed point-index pairs. RESULT A]
            [COMMAND For each j from 1 to N-1 inclusive, set x2 and y2 from XY[j]; for each i from 0 to j-1 inclusive, set x1 and y1 from XY[i], compute a = x2 - x1 and b = y2 - y1, divide a and b by gcd(a, b), then append (i, j) to A[(a, b)] and append (j, i) to A[(-a, -b)], creating the list if the key is absent. RESULT A]
            [COMMAND Initialize m to 1. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND For each direction key (a, b) in A, fetch E = A[(a, b)], build outgoing adjacency O and incoming adjacency I for all directed pairs (i, j) in E, compute NI = set(range(N)) - set(I), and for each source node x in NI, create a chain list starting with x followed by the outgoing neighbors of x sorted by indegree and then node index; if x has no outgoing neighbors, use the singleton list [x]. Collect these chains as C. RESULT C]
            [COMMAND Partition the current C into C1 (chains of length 1), C2 (even-length chains), and C3 (odd-length chains longer than 1); while C3 has more than one chain, remove the last two chains, concatenate them, and append the result to C2; finally replace C3 with the first two elements of C3 + C1. RESULT C1_C2_C3]
            [COMMAND Compute l2 as the sum of lengths of chains in C2 and l3 as the sum of lengths of chains in C3; if l3 is nonzero set l = l2 + l3; else if C2 contains more than one chain set l = l2 - 1; else set l = l2; then update m to max(m, l). RESULT m]
            [COMMAND After all direction keys have been processed, print the formatted output line containing 'Case #%d: %d' with cnum and m. RESULT printed_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
